description: Qualifying surviving spouse, $212,000 wages, 2 kids. QSS uses the MFJ std deduction ($31,500) and MFJ brackets, BUT the $400k CTC threshold is joint-return-only -> QSS threshold $200k -> excess $12,000 -> $600 reduction. Taxable $180,500 -> tax 2,385 + 8,772 + 22%*83,550 = $29,538.00; CTC $4,400-$600=$3,800 -> $25,738.00. QSS Additional-Medicare threshold is $200k (not a joint return): +$108.00.
